name: Studio Composition Runtime
purpose: Canonical, dependency-free (GSAP 3.12.5 core only) runtime for HyperFrames compositions: format-aware layout variables, seeded randomness, path drawing and morphing, text splitting and typography motion, masks and scene transitions, depth/parallax, rhythm helpers, textures, reusable compositions and five style systems. Projects vendor a locked copy under src/_studio/.
capabilities: studio-core.js: format, safe areas, seeded rng/noise, timeline registration, scene show/hide/crossfade/cut
studio-draw.js: stroke draw, line art, hand-drawn lines, blobs, waves, morph, wobble, particles
studio-type.js: accessible split, mask rise, cascade, tracking, weight, typewriter, highlight, underline, counters
studio-motion.js: reveal/wipe/iris/push/shape-cover/liquid/match-cut transitions, depth camera, assembly, rhythm grid, grain
studio-compositions.js: title card, item list, step header, end card, captions
studio-base.css + styles/*.css: tokens, type scale per format, layout primitives, style systems
studio-rig.js (1.4.0): articulated character rig (FK, contact anchors, IK, followers, cycles)
kits/fitness/ (1.4.0): Sinew fitness kit (see shared-fitness-kit)
studio-rig.js (1.5.0): derive hook, attributes computed from each solved pose and tweened per move sample
kits/fitness/sculpt.js (1.5.0): Cobalt Sculpt Tibi, male and female (see shared-fitness-kit)
studio-rig.js (1.6.0): per-joint foreshortening (pose.f) for views toward or away from the camera
kits/fitness/exercises.js (1.6.0): 12 upper-body exercises on Tibi with flat-plane equipment; classic tibi.js retired

kits/fitness/tibi3d.js + exercises3d.js + vendor/three.min.js (1.7.0): Tibi in real 3D (skinned figure, muscles that never pop, free camera, pure-function-of-time motion tracks) with curl, bench press and lateral raise; QA by scripts/rig3d-check.js, rig3d-stills.py, motion-continuity.py

1.8.0: 3D lower body (squat and knees-blocked squat, hip thrust, standing and seated calf raise; glute, adductor, soleus; heel lift; chest-frame arm IK; stage.views split screens; muscles under clothing warm through a deep role colour) and kits/fitness/film3d.js (overlays, pins, camera shots, bar panels for narrated 3D films)

1.9.0: anatomy 1.0 (one skin: surface activation, cutaways, isolation, skeleton), phase machine per 3D exercise, scene library, instructional overlays, frame-0 title cards; the dumbbell-press figure-id fix
1.9.1: seek-stable fitness skin, toe and anatomy-mode state; scene visibility set before drawing; bounded split-view projection cameras
1.9.2: optional distance-based Tibi profile sampling, with separate caches
1.10.0: integrated 3D anatomy by default, figure-local morph normals, bounded activation mixing, finer joint detail and torso-owned garment; explicit legacy preserved
1.11.0: sloping shoulder envelope, rounded deltoid fans and a separated neutral arm stance
1.12.0: flank and hip contours without ledges (thin serratus sheet, rounded pec ends, deep glute medius, rounded leg-tube tops); legacy unchanged
1.13.0: stage.fit, T3.framePoints, T3.fitScene and T3.scene({fit}) solve a 3D camera from the posed body and equipment over a whole set

1.14.0: 3D known-limit fixes (anatomy 1.4.0, Tibi 0.6.0): glute, effort/cloth tint, glute cutaway, female deltoid, shoulder ridge, fold correctives, ponytail follow-through, bench arch, bending sole; legacy unchanged
1.15.0: anatomy 1.6.0 and Tibi 0.8.0 (shoulder girdle), 3D exercise families 1-2, sculpt 2.2.0, studio-film.js helpers, kits/fitness/stations.js

1.15.1: exercise-card fit (stations.js): reading text never below 2.6% of the short side, chips drop before text shrinks (prime movers kept), fit measures content not the flex slot; audit reports card-below-floor

1.16.0: Tibi 0.9.0 (garS hand-roll branch), 3D exercise family 3 on the shoulder girdle (overhead press, lat pulldown, pull-up, seated cable row, one-arm row and their mistake variants); anatomy 1.6.0 and sculpt 2.2.0 unchanged

1.17.0: reference-backlog techniques: Studio.fx.flash, Studio.fx.containerTransform, Studio.type.scramble, Studio.type.strike / strikeCorrect, caption lane 'subject' (cue.anchor; storyboard caption_anchor); checks in tests/studio-runtime/backlog-techniques.html, frame review in tests/reference-derived/flash-and-container and scramble-strike-caption; fitness kit unchanged

1.18.0: explanation devices in studio-explain.js, one per narrator job (specs/explanation-devices.json): comp.equation, comp.slider, comp.tracePair, comp.simulation (+ simulationScript), comp.barRace, comp.progression, comp.copySlot, comp.ui widgets, comp.headline pair/build, space.tour, fx.dip; each keeps its state in one seek-safe proxy value; checks in tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html, golden scenes with frame review in tests/reference-derived/explain-*; fitness kit unchanged

installation.instructions: python3 scripts/studio.py sync <slug> copies it into projects/<slug>/src/_studio/ with studio.lock.json.

compatibility.notes: Current 1.12.0 flank/hip and 1.11.0 shoulder/arm geometry are checked on Windows. Historical Mac renders do not approve this version. Runtime synchronization is required; Mac production and human fitness accuracy review remain pending.

licensing.notes: Original workspace code; no third-party code copied. GSAP is loaded separately (see library record).

security.notes: Runs inside the render browser only; no network calls of its own.

approval_evidence: 1.12.0, Windows 2026-11-21: 59 anatomy/rig/fitness tests and 40 temporal cases pass; the new flank/hip gate rejects the old serratus slab, glute-medius shelf and flat leg top in the actual checker; all 81 explicit-legacy seek images are byte-identical to the 1.11 run. 1.11.0, Windows 2026-11-20: 59 tests, 40 temporal cases and both locality cases pass. All 20 legacy images match 1.10, whose legacy references match 1.9.2. Eighty authored exercise/phase pose, bone and prop states remain exact. Current neutral stance intentionally changes; authored tracks, timing and 2D art do not. Mac/human approval pending.
